title: The instruction asks the agent to project each segment using its historical Year 1 to Year 3 CAGR, but the workbook has no segments and the golden answer applies no CAGR anywhere. It is a store and square-footage build: comparable sales = prior sqft × prior sales/sqft × (1+SSS), plus new-store sales.
evidence: Prompt: 'Project each segment using its historical CAGR from Year 1 to Year 3.' The golden F20=170.334 equals E33/E16 (9325792.5/54750), not any CAGR extrapolation. A CAGR on C20:E20 gives 164.9×(164.9/142.5)^0.5≈177.4.
